extracted.name: Baked Parmesan Asparagus
extracted.description: Baked asparagus topped with Parmesan cheese is a simple pairing that's easy to prep for an elegant and delicious spring side dish.
instruction_lines: Gather the ingredients. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (205 degrees C). Grease a baking sheet with cooking spray.
Lightly spray asparagus with cooking spray; place onto the prepared baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until tender, about 12 minutes, flipping spears halfway through.
Meanwhile, mix Parmesan cheese and garlic salt together in a small bowl.
Remove asparagus from the oven and sprinkle Parmesan mixture over top.
